description_en: Call `GetVpcEndpointServiceAttribute` to retrieve the properties of an endpoint service in your account
description_zh: 调用GetVpcEndpointServiceAttribute接口，查询归属当前账号的终端节点服务属性信息
kebab_example: aliyun privatelink get-vpc-endpoint-service-attribute --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --service-id epsrv-hp3vpx8yqxblby3i0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetVpcEndpointServiceAttribute

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the region where the endpoint service is located.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/120468.html operation to obtain the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
终端节点服务所属的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/120468.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the endpoint service
parameters.name: service_id

AddressIpVersion.description_en:
The IP address version. Valid values:

IPv4: The IPv4 address family.

DualStack: The dual stack IP address family
AddressIpVersion.description_zh:
协议版本。取值：

IPv4：IPv4类型。
DualStack：双栈类型

AutoAcceptEnabled.description_en:
Specifies whether to automatically accept endpoint connections. Valid values:

true: Endpoint connections are automatically accepted.

false: Endpoint connections are not automatically accepted
AutoAcceptEnabled.description_zh:
是否自动接受终端节点连接，取值：

true：自动接受终端节点连接。

false：不自动接受终端节点连接

ConnectBandwidth.description_en: The default maximum bandwidth of an endpoint connection, in Mbps. Valid values are 100 to 10,240
ConnectBandwidth.description_zh: 默认连接带宽峰值。单位：Mbps。取值范围：100~10240

CreateTime.description_en: The time the service was created
CreateTime.description_zh: 终端节点服务的创建时间

MaxBandwidth.description_en: The maximum bandwidth of the endpoint connection, in Mbps
MaxBandwidth.description_zh: 终端节点连接的最大带宽。单位：Mbps

MinBandwidth.description_en: The minimum bandwidth of the endpoint connection, in Mbps
MinBandwidth.description_zh: 终端节点连接的最小带宽。单位：Mbps

Payer.description_en:
The party that pays for the service. Valid values:

Endpoint: The service consumer.

EndpointService: The service provider
Payer.description_zh:
付费方，取值：

Endpoint：服务使用方。
EndpointService：服务提供方

RegionId.description_en: The region where the service is deployed
RegionId.description_zh: 终端节点服务所属的地域

ResourceGroupId.description_en: The ID of the resource group

ServiceBusinessStatus.description_en:
The business status of the service. Valid values:

Normal: The service is operating normally.

FinancialLocked: The endpoint service is locked due to an overdue payment
ServiceBusinessStatus.description_zh:
终端节点服务的业务状态，取值：

Normal：正常。

FinancialLocked：欠费锁定

ServiceDescription.description_zh: 终端节点服务的描述信息

ServiceDomain.description_en: The domain name of the service
ServiceDomain.description_zh: 终端节点服务的服务域名

ServiceResourceType.description_en:
The type of the service resource. Valid values:

slb: The service resource is a Classic Load Balancer (CLB).

alb: The service resource is an Application Load Balancer (ALB).

nlb: The service resource is a Network Load Balancer (NLB).

gwlb: The service resource is a Gateway Load Balancer (GWLB)
ServiceResourceType.description_zh:
服务资源类型，取值：

slb：表示服务资源类型为传统型负载均衡CLB（Classic Load Balancer）。
alb：表示服务资源类型为应用型负载均衡ALB（Application Load Balancer）。
nlb ：表示服务资源类型为网络型负载均衡NLB（Network Load Balancer ）。
gwlb : 表示服务资源类型为网关型负载均衡 GWLB（Gateway Load Balancer）

ServiceStatus.description_en:
The status of the service. Valid values:

Creating: The service is being created.

Pending: The service is being updated.

Active: The service is available.

Deleting: The service is being deleted
ServiceStatus.description_zh:
终端节点服务的状态，取值：

Creating：创建中。

Pending：修改中。

Active：可用。

Deleting：删除中

ServiceSupportIPv6.description_en:
Specifies whether the service supports IPv6. Valid values:

true: The service supports IPv6.

false (default): The service does not support IPv6
ServiceSupportIPv6.description_zh:
终端节点服务是否支持IPv6功能。取值：

true：是。
false（默认值）：否

ServiceType.description_en:
The endpoint type.

Interface: An interface endpoint. You can add Classic Load Balancer (CLB), Application Load Balancer (ALB), and Network Load Balancer (NLB) instances as service resources.

GatewayLoadBalancer: A gateway endpoint. You can add Gateway Load Balancer (GWLB) instances as service resources
ServiceType.description_zh:
终端节点类型。

Interface：表示接口终端节点，您可以添加传统型负载均衡CLB（Classic Load Balancer）、应用型负载均衡ALB（Application Load Balancer）和网络型负载均衡NLB（Network Load Balancer ）的服务资源类型。
GatewayLoadBalancer： 表示网关型负载均衡终端节点，您可以添加网关型负载均衡 GWLB（Gateway Load Balancer）作为服务资源

SupportedRegionSet.description_en: The regions where the service is supported. Service consumers can create endpoint connections to the service from these regions
SupportedRegionSet.description_zh: 终端节点服务支持的地域列表，服务使用方可从列表中的地域发起终端节点连接

RegionBusinessStatus.description_en:
The business status of the endpoint service in the supported region. Valid values:

Normal: The service is operating normally in the supported region.

FinancialLocked: The endpoint service is locked due to an overdue payment
RegionBusinessStatus.description_zh:
终端节点服务支持的地域的业务状态。取值：

Normal：正常。
FinancialLocked：欠费锁定

RegionServiceStatus.description_en:
The status of the endpoint service in the supported region. Valid values:

Pending: The supported region is being modified.

Available: The service is available in the supported region.

Deleting: The supported region is being deleted.

Failed: The service failed to be deployed in the supported region.

Closed: The endpoint service is not available in the supported region
RegionServiceStatus.description_zh:
终端节点服务支持的地域的状态。取值：

Pending：变更中。
Available：可用。
Deleting：删除中。
Failed：失败。
Closed：关闭

SupportedRegionId.description_en: The ID of the supported region
SupportedRegionId.description_zh: 终端节点服务支持的地域 ID

ZoneAffinityEnabled.description_en:
Specifies whether zone affinity is enabled. Valid values:

true (default): Zone affinity is enabled.

false: Zone affinity is disabled
ZoneAffinityEnabled.description_zh:
是否支持连接服务的终端节点域名就近解析。取值：

true（默认值）：是。
false：否

Zones.description_en: The zones where the service is available
Zones.description_zh: 服务资源所属的可用区列表

items.description_en: A zone where the service is available
items.description_zh: 服务资源所属的可用区
